title: Sullen Eyed Ginger Bot
details: This ginger bot knows her role. You can see it in her eyes that she's accepting her new path in life. The way she licks the floor and cleans up the shoes with her tongue, says it all. Her somber eyes with every gulp of yellow discipline is an hour on a therapists couch. She's perfect. She got her holes fucked and bred and had 3 more dumped on her milk white face.
